legs.name: Jonathan Taylor
legs.why: Give us Jonathan Taylor under 75.5 rushing yards. He closed last season with games of 87, 46, 70, 26 yards (season line ~94.6).

sunday_stack.note: 4 of our own recommended bets, one per game so the legs are independent and the book prices them as a plain product. Pays about 11:1. On our numbers it cashes 13% of the time (fair odds +682) — a parlay compounds the edge, so the expected return is +55% per dollar IF the legs' edges are real. Sized as a parlay, tracked as its own record. Most weeks it loses; the wins are big and it's positive-expectation, which is the point.

td_stack.note: 3 real scorers (each 39%+ to find the end zone on our numbers), one per game so they're independent, each at the best price across draftkings/fanatics; built for the highest chance to cash among +EV scorers, not the biggest number. Pays ~18:1; cashes 8% of the time on our numbers (fair +1194), +47% expected return per dollar IF the edges are real. Why no stars: last season's 1-TD-a-game backs score in ~51% of the next season's games (measured), and the market prices them at 64-76% — so the +EV touchdowns live at plus money, and three of them pay 15-30:1. A real-edge lotto-lite, sized small, not a lock.
